notes: DRAFT for Jay's read and edit (L17-C, Jay t1031u Nov 16). Not for release until Jay approves. Same format as content/street-smarts/store-separated.json, so loadScenario reads it. Threats are implied, never shown: the stranger is an ordinary, friendly-looking grown-up who never touches, grabs or threatens. Every kid line is 8 words or fewer. Rewards: stars and the location badge only, no power and no fight bonus (Jay Q6a, Nov 14). Helpers, secret word and Mom/Dad follow J11.
topic: A grown-up you don't know offers a treat at the park

characters.note: An ordinary adult the player doesn't know. Smiling, not scary or mean. Stays a few steps away. Never grabs, follows or threatens. Leaves quietly.
Mom or Dad (ui.json grownups). Calm, warm, never angry.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: {grownup} sits on a bench by the swings.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A grown-up {player} doesn't know walks over.

treat-good.speaker: sensei
treat-good.text: Good. You can always say no thank you.

treat-retry.speaker: sensei
treat-retry.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Come on, I have more over here.

move-good.speaker: sensei

move-retry-talk.speaker: sensei
move-retry-talk.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

move-retry-talk.speaker: sensei
move-retry-talk.text: Who is the safest person at the park?

move-retry-go.text: Let's see what could have gone differently.

move-retry-go.speaker: sensei
move-retry-go.text: Only go places when {grownup} says yes.

choices.text: A grown-up I don't know offered candy.

tell-good.speaker: grownup
tell-good.text: You can always tell me anything.

tell-retry.speaker: sensei

tell-retry.speaker: sensei
tell-retry.text: How can {grownup} help if they don't know?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then they play catch together, smiling.

lines.text: What did you do that helped?

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: And you told them what happened.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: That is how you stay safe.

stars.rule: Best choice on the first try at treat, move and tell earns 1 star each. A retry still finishes the scenario and can be replayed for all 3 stars.
stars.note: Street Smarts power is 0 (Jay Q6a). Stars and the badge are the reward.

badge.name: Park Badge
badge.book: Said no thanks, then told a grown-up.
badge.rule: Location set done: every scenario at this location with at least 2 stars (core-design section 12). Shows in the Book (L10).

townLight.line: The park lights glow on the town map!
townLight.note: Looks only. The Park spot on the town map lights up when the badge is earned. No power.
